development_protocol: Stratified 5-Fold Cross-Validation on N=42 Development Subjects
locked_test_rule: Test labels were NEVER inspected during selection or tuning

preprocessing.rationale: Maximized development CV stability and compatibility across models

augmentation.rationale: Improved 3D ResNet-18 CV AUC from 0.8125 to 0.8450 without distorting anatomy

selected_ensemble.rationale: Achieved highest development CV AUC (0.9325) by pairing high-capacity CNN with shifted-window transformer

selected_fusion.rationale: Highest feature fusion development CV AUC (0.9800) and Balanced Accuracy (0.9278)
